messages:
alex: Heads up — embeddings-prod is returning 503s for long-context requests. We traced it to a kv-cache eviction bug introduced in the last quant build. Need an expedited hotfix deploy in the next 30m. Pinned image: redwood/embeddings:c2f3b9f. Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 10% (10m) -> 100% if green. @release-eng @sre-oncall
release-eng: Ack. Need an owner and explicit rollback criteria before we cut.
alex: I'll own the deploy. Rollback criteria: error rate >1% absolute increase vs baseline OR p95 latency >500ms sustained for 3 consecutive mins.
deploy-bot: Release request received for redwood/embeddings:c2f3b9f. Preparing canary rollout. Scheduled start ETA 1744447860.
taylor: :thumbsup: I approve expedited deploy. Please tag release notes when done. Link placeholder: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/1744447777
morgan: Quick Q — any DB schema/migration required?
alex: No migrations. Runtime-only fix, kv cache tuning. Should be safe to rollout.
sre-oncall: Oncall acked. I will monitor metrics, and I have rollback permissions if we hit thresholds.
release-eng: Add this snippet to the PR release notes before cut: "Fix eviction logic causing 503s for long contexts; no data migration required."
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1744447860 on pool eu-west1-canary-1 (5%).
taylor: Observability checks are warming up. Traces look clean so far.
morgan: Quick perf check looks fine — p95 unchanged in my probes.
deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 10% at 1744447920. Running 10m verification window.
sre-oncall: Error rate current 0.20% (baseline 0.15%) — within the rollback threshold. Continuing watch.
release-eng: Alex — once 100% is complete paste the final release-note link here and I'll push to #release-notes.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1744448005. No automated rollback triggered.
alex: Deployed to prod and monitoring. No anomalies observed in the 15m post-rollout window. Will file a short postmortem and update changelog.
taylor: Nice work, team. :party_parrot:
